name: Maze Pacman
description: A neon-blue maze that Pac-Man plays by himself: he eats the dots, dodges four ghosts that chase him, and the board refills when it is clear. Time stacked in double-line blue digits, weekday and seconds beside the maze.

steps.script: await registerCustomFont({ name: 'seven-segment.ttf', family: 'Seven Segment', format: 'truetype', ext: '.ttf', dataBase64: '' }); return 1
const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n - 3, n - 2, n - 1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Aod'; return 1

project.groups = project.groups || {}; let k = 0; for (const e of project.elements) if (/ Aod$/.test(e.name)) { e.group = 'gClockAod'; k++; } project.groups.gClockAod = 'Clock AOD'; return k + ' ' + project.elements.map((e) => e.name).join(',')

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gClock = 'Clock'; let n = 0; for (const nm of ['Second', 'Minute', 'Hour']) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); if (e) { e.group = 'gClock'; n++ } } return n
